proposals.rationale: The existing disposable laboratory has exactly one Jira service with CLUSTERED=false. The 10.3.26 qualification observed native HTTP405 for GET cluster/nodes. This proves neither missing Jira version/plugin nor successful node enumeration. The fixture supplies no second owned node, dead-node lifecycle or rolling-upgrade population. An invented node ID, absent task or validation error would not prove runtime unavailability or successful cluster effects.
proposals.requiredForQualification: An owner-approved multi-node fixture within the existing laboratory, versioned node snapshots and independent observations of each requested cluster effect.

proposals.rationale: A fresh version-bound Jira database does not supply a pending native upgrade. A no-work acknowledgement cannot establish execution and readback of upgrade tasks. Reusing another release's volume would violate the laboratory's release isolation.
proposals.requiredForQualification: An owner-approved, snapshot-backed pending-upgrade fixture and independent native task/result observations, without using another operator's data or crossing the release boundary implicitly.

proposals.rationale: The normal disposable setup disables outgoing email. The native notification request has no recipient-delivery readback; neither a successful acknowledgement nor a missing SMTP configuration proves delivery or a missing Jira capability.
proposals.requiredForQualification: An owner-approved synthetic mail sink integrated into the existing laboratory and an independent matching delivery observation. No real recipient or external mail service is selected by this proposal.
